name: SyncMark
title: One mark across every phone.
full: One tap flashes and beeps after a shared countdown choice of 0, 1, 3 or 5 seconds. Each phone starts that countdown when it handles the message. This is an approximate marker, not professional timecode, and no network latency was measured.
screenshotNote: Aucune capture réelle d’écran n’a été faite sur un téléphone. Ne pas publier de maquettes à la place.
